warrior_minas_tirith: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the APPROVED complete Minas Tirith infantry sprite and is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the original approved Theoden art style/camera reference. We rejected newer candidates because they drifted toward a frontal camera and long realistic bodies. Correct that by retaining image 1's EXACT camera, helmet/head size, compressed five-head body proportions, shoulder/torso widths, short foreshortened thighs and calves, pixel density and palette. Do NOT reinterpret the anatomy, do NOT lengthen limbs or shrink head, do NOT show more face, do NOT lift camera to eye level. The helmet crown and shoulder tops remain strongly visible; gaze points down into the battlefield, NOT toward viewer. Keep black White Tree tabard, silver armour, black White Tree pointed shield and straight sword. Change ONLY the combat pose into a quiet sentinel: right elbow bent with sword near-upright beside shoulder, left shield angled slightly away beside thigh, two feet planted with a small weight shift. Retain short 5-head compact body EXACTLY as target image 1; pose variation must not add physical height or reveal extra long legs. Not chibi, not 6/7/8-head realistic anatomy. One complete transparent sprite, entire sword, head and boots visible, ample transparent margin on every side, no platform, shadow, background, text or additional figures. First priority exact approved camera and proportions; second priority modest arm/foot pose variation.
aragorn: Use case: precise-object-edit and costume transformation. ONE isolated game unit sprite. Input image 1 is the APPROVED FIVE-HEAD HIGH-ANGLE FRONT-VIEW body and camera, and is the structural EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is the original Theoden PIXEL DRAWING style; input image 3 is the requested character's old asset, for costume, weapons, colour and identity ONLY. CRITICAL FIXED RULES: retain image 1's exact elevated camera (view down onto the upper head, both shoulders and footwear); high-angle FRONT VIEW, NOT eye-level front view. Keep compact FIVE-HEAD anatomy, same large head-to-body relation, short foreshortened thighs and lower legs. Never lengthen legs, stretch torso, shrink head or increase visible body length to express tallness. Do not borrow long anatomy/camera from image 3. All body/pose variation is subordinate to image 1. Heads face down the battlefield as in image 1; little face is visible below brow/hair, NO looking up at viewer. Pixel art with the SAME coarse purposeful pixel clusters, hard dark edge and restrained dither texture as Theoden, NOT smooth illustration, vector, airbrush, 3D, realistic anatomy or 6+ heads. Each sprite must work at 86 world pixels. Entire body and all equipment inside generous true transparent margins; no ground/shadow/base/disk/text/panels. Transform the soldier into ARAGORN RANGER ON FOOT, preserving image 3's dark shoulder-length hair, short dark beard, green cloak and silver clasp, brown/dark ranger leather over mail, straight sword. Body variation only: slightly narrower shoulder/waist/upper arms than image 1, lean but compact five-head anatomy. Pose: modest grounded guard with one foot angled outward, knees softly bent, two hands grip sword low diagonally across waist pointing to lower left; cloak falls mostly behind, no giant dramatic flaring. Keep elevated head/camera exactly image 1; heavy hair/brow shadow hides most eyes.
